## Customer disclosure and recalls
Customers must receive, before purchase, clear safety instructions covering installation, ventilation, warning signs, emergency response, and available shut-off functions. A mandatory safety-action trigger occurs when any model exceeds 8 confirmed thermal incidents per 100,000 installed units in a rolling 12-month period. The regulator must require a proportionate corrective action, which may include repair, retrofit, replacement, or recall; exceeding the threshold does not by itself impose an automatic market ban.
